name: 表示チャンネルを選ぶ案内
prompt:
Produce the second render of the same Japanese Discord channel-choice onboarding card. Keep the exact content, illustration, colors, typography and visual style from the native Japanese preview and v001. This is a geometry correction, not a redesign. The output canvas must match the native 390x284 proportion.

Use the full canvas correctly: the pale mint rounded panel should span x30 to x360 and y8 to y270 on a 390x284 logical canvas (about 85% of canvas width and 92% of canvas height), leaving 30px side margins, only 8px top margin and 14px bottom margin. In v001 the panel is too inset and starts too far down; enlarge it to these dimensions.

Keep the gray close X centered near x343 y28. Set the white rounded illustration window to about x80 y20, width230 and height131. Center the dark charcoal channel illustration inside it at about x99 y31, width197 and height119. Preserve all four rows, their # marks and bars, the small green heart on the first row and the red X with faint radial ticks on the third row. Keep the illustration ending just above the title.

Keep the bold centered title 「表示するチャンネルを選ぶ」 beginning near y167, about 20px in the logical canvas. Below it, center the exact three body lines in the same small dark-green type and original line spacing: 「関心のある会話だけを一覧に表示できます。」 / 「自分へのメンションがある会話は、」 / 「非表示にしていても一覧に表示されます。」. Preserve the exact wording and use the native modest font sizes. Do not paraphrase or add text.

No hyperlink text appears in the Japanese native component; keep this title and body text in their native dark colors. If a real hyperlink label is included, it must be blue. The source English BETA pill is a status badge, not a hyperlink, and must remain excluded.

Exclude phone status bar, app header, tabs, search field, channel list, Discord/Mobbin footer and all other screen chrome. Do not add buttons, badges, shadows, avatars or extra icons. Use the native preview as the exact authority for card size, content positions, Japanese text and colors. Use v001 only to retain the card and illustration style.
reviewNotes: v002を実画像で目視。日本語見出しと説明3行、4行チャンネル図、ハート/赤いX、閉じるXを保持。日本語nativeにはリンク文言がない。パネルの上/下余白はnativeに近づいたが、横幅がnativeより広い。2回の限定生成を保存し、残差をneeds-correctionのまま次IDへ渡す。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。

inputReferences.role: Primary native preview: authoritative 390x284 card, text, proportions and illustration
Correction target: LH03-0163 v001; preserve content and illustration while enlarging the panel and illustration toward native size
